verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents exposing specific TCP ports on a sandbox so external clients can reach web servers, dev servers and other services inside it (docs-23). It also offers direct preview URLs backed by a running sandbox, with optional token auth for private URLs and support for custom domains (docs-33, docs-8, docs-3), and its built-in MCP server exposes port and preview tools (docs-38). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that port-to-preview-URL exposure works as documented.
